findings.issue: Unmarked el adds definiteness; the token is only a preposition plus an anarthrous cardinal (HR/Acmsa).
The infinitive suffix is 3mp (their going out); with Moisés as the nearby singular, su salir can read as his going out.

notes: Jehová, Moisés, anarthrous desierto and tienda, al mes el segundo, en el año el segundo, desde tierra de Egipto, and diciendo match the remaining tokens.
